mapper.select: select l.id, l.tenant_id as tenantId, l.notice_id as noticeId, l.channel, l.target_scope as targetScope, l.target_user_id as targetUserId, l.target_user_name as targetUserName, l.target_email as targetEmail, l.title, l.content, l.send_status as sendStatus, l.error_message as errorMessage, l.sent_at as sentAt, l.created_by as createdBy, l.created_at as createdAt from msg_delivery_log l where order by l.created_at desc, l.id desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset}
